newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Dunklin School District, Mo.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Dunklin School District, Mo.

text.p: Board of Education Dunklin R-V School District

Sealed bids will be received by the Treasurer of the Board of Education (the Board'') of the Dunklin R-V School District, Missouri (the for the purchase of $1,500,000 aggregate principal amount of General Obligation Bonds, Series 1996 (the Bonds'') of the District. Sealed bids will be received at the Board Room of the District at 217 Barclay Street, P.O. Box 306 Herculaneum, Missouri 63048-0306, on Monday,
until 3:00 p.m. central time. The bids received will be publicly read and considered by the Board at a regular meeting to be held on Monday, September 16, 1996, at 7:30 p.m. central time.
The Bonds will be dated September 24, 1996, will be fully registered bonds in denominations of $5,000 or integral multiples thereof, and will mature serially on March 1 as follows:

Additional information, including copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement, bidding forms and other related information, may be obtained from L.J. Hart & Company, 16100 North Outer Forty Road, Suite 100, St. Louis, Missouri 63017, (314) 537-9939, fax (314) 537-9005, the Financial Advisor to the District.
